comments.body:
Pushed as Gerrit change 3065: commit ad630728043, rebased onto S8 (2ece4c6b312, now origin/main). The rebase had 14 conflicts:
- import lines in 12 files: kept the scratch_retention import and the typed-payload imports, and dropped the deleted `summary_route` import;
- the CHANGELOG.md and release-notes.md entries: all of them are kept, and each was checked to match the commit it came from.

`make verify` on the rebased tree exited 0 (19712 passed, 86 skipped). The pre-rebase run also exited 0 (19701 passed).

The diff is 87 files (1343 insertions, 4642 deletions). The only file outside the declared impact is `CHANGELOG.md` (the BREAKING entry).

AC evidence:
- the 5 modules are gone from the tree;
- `len(_VALID_COMBINATIONS) == 10 == set(_LEAVES)`, pinned in `test_mutation.py` and `test_outbound_pass_typed_payload_cutover.py`;
- `outbound_fields.py` is 192 LOC, and its only function is `_map_local_to_jira_fields`;
- the Testing-section grep over src is empty.

Sizes: `applier.py` 759 LOC, `batch_dispatch.py` 729.

Ratchets:
- complexity `new=0 increased=0`; `_diff_fields` and `applier.apply` are now stale;
- mechanism `--update-stale` dropped `env_var::REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE` and the `test_dc_summary_executor.py` autouse fixture;
- the env registry now has 148 variables, and the `test_gen_env_registry.py` floor is 148.

Deviations from the plan:
1. `_build_leaves` raises `RuntimeError` instead of using `assert`, so the check survives `python -O`.
2. The batch form validates the whole batch before the mode-cap split, so a plain-dict create fails before any inbound write.
3. `test_summary_asymmetry_never_suppressed` is deleted. It pinned dead `_diff_fields` behaviour that the live diff contradicts, and live title-sync coverage is in `test_inbound_field_sync_directionality.py`.
4. The manifest and preview tests now expect the typed payload's dict form.

Not run: 2 external tests that build plain-dict payloads but do not go through the batch form (`test_link_sync_roundtrip_live.py`, `test_cloud_coordinator_lifecycle.py`). External tests are not part of `make verify`.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The summary-executor trio (`summary_route.py`, `adapters/jira/summary_operation.py`, `adapters/jira_datacenter/summary_executor.py`) is injected only by tests: the one production `BatchApplyContext` (`applier.py:598-603`) passes no `summary_executor`, and nothing calls `JiraBackend.execute_summary_operation`/`observe_summary_operation`. `payload_shadow.py` is a test-only comparator. `apply()`'s batch form still accepts raw dicts (`applier.py:432` `else m`), and `_mutation_to_batch_dict` keeps a two-shape CREATE heuristic for plain-dict payloads (`batch_dispatch.py:180-191`) that no production producer reaches. Its docstring (`:120-122,162-165`) says no producer builds a plain-dict payload; two do, via that branch: `binding_walk.py:255-264` (outbound update, `changed_fields`) and `differ.py:400-404` (outbound probe, `{}`). `_VALID_COMBINATIONS` (`mutation.py:37-42`) admits 12 pairs; `typed_dispatch._build_leaves` (`:55-66`) registers 10, none for `(inbound, delete)`/`(inbound, probe)`, and no production code builds either. In `adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py` (651 LOC) the only production use is `_map_local_to_jira_fields` (`adapters/jira/backend.py:26,70`); `_load_adf` (`:71-85`) and everything from `_extract_jira_field` (`:222`) to EOF, `_diff_fields` included, has no production caller (the live diff is `outbound_field_diff.compute_update_fields`), yet 9 test files drive `_diff_fields`/`_extract_jira_field`, and `:426` is the only read of `REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE`. `_concurrency.py` has one production importer, `applier._load_concurrency` (`:227-230`), whose module object is threaded into `_recheck_drift` (`applier_drift_guard.py:85-100`) and `batch_dispatch` (`:592-607,689-765`). `acli_subprocess._MAX_BACKOFF_S` (`:148`) duplicates `_errors.MAX_BACKOFF_S` (`:29`). Three stale `REBAR_RECONCILER_STATUS_GATING` comments remain. Cites are on origin/main 754994fd6c5.

## Approach
1. Delete the trio, `BatchApplyContext.summary_executor` (`apply_handlers.py:81-87`), its import (`:56-59`), `_route_summary_via_executor` (`:406-425`), the branch at `:432-438`, `JiraBackend.execute_summary_operation`/`observe_summary_operation` (`adapters/jira/backend.py:324-346`), and `acli_rest.py`'s `_OneAttemptNoSleep`/`ONE_ATTEMPT_NO_SLEEP` with its `dataclass` import (`:26,32-49`) and the `retry_policy` kwarg (`:63-93,229-254,359-371`; sole passer `summary_operation.py:178`). Delete the trio's 3 test files; `test_apply_handlers_operation_outcome.py` keeps only `:85`, `:206`.
2. Delete `payload_shadow.py`, `tests/fixtures/reconciler/payload_corpus/` and `test_payload_shadow_{corpus,effect_spies,route_census}.py`, moving its typed-payload guards (`:55-77`) into `test_outbound_pass_typed_payload_cutover.py`. Fix the `mutation_payloads.py:27-33,387-394` docstrings and `docs/architecture.md:146-191`.
3. `applier.apply`'s batch form accepts `Sequence[Mutation]` only: `:432` converts every element, and a non-`MutationShape` one raises `TypeError`. `_mutation_to_batch_dict` keeps the typed reads plus one plain-dict read (update: `changed_fields`; other actions: no fields); the CREATE heuristic and update `"fields"` fallback (`:173-191`) go, a plain-dict create raises `TypeError`, and the docstring is corrected. Retarget onto typed `Mutation`s the 17 test files that pass raw-dict batches to `apply()` and the 7 that build plain-dict creates (found by an instrumented run; all in file impact).
4. `_VALID_COMBINATIONS` becomes an explicit 10-pair frozenset; `typed_dispatch._build_leaves` asserts `set(handlers) == _VALID_COMBINATIONS`. Rewrite the dead-pair users (`test_coordinator_route_census.py:186-198`, `test_mutation.py:247-253`, the `_make_mutations` of `test_mode_cap_enforcement.py`/`test_bridge_cap_heldout.py`); fix the `mutation_payloads.py:1-11` and `test_mutation_payloads.py:231-246` docstrings.
5. Delete `outbound_fields.py:71-85,222-651` and its unused `importlib.util`/`os`/`sys` imports; rewrite the module docstring. Retarget the 9 test files that drive the dead half (8 unit files in file impact, plus `tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py:536,565,703`) onto `outbound_field_diff.compute_update_fields` (delete cases with no live equivalent). The `.github/complexity-baseline.json` `_diff_fields` key becomes `stale` (not edited; stale passes). Regenerate `docs/env-vars.md` without `REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE`, point `tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py:38` at `REBAR_RECONCILER_LOCK_STEAL`, drop the `test_rich_text_seam.py:221` allowlist row.
6. Fold `_concurrency.snapshot_head` and `EMPTY_REPO_SENTINEL` into `applier.py`; delete `_load_concurrency` and `_concurrency.py`. `_apply_batch` passes `snapshot_head` where it passed the module (`:545,607,624,634`); `_recheck_drift`, `make_guarded_execute`, `run_migrated_reroute` and `reroute_migrated_plans` take that callable (`concurrency=` becomes `snapshot_head=`). The 16 test files that patch `_load_concurrency`, import `_concurrency` or pass `concurrency=` follow (file impact), among them the shared `mutate/_coordinator_harness.py:213`, `test_operation_coordinator.py` and `test_coordinator_venue_cutover.py`; `test_retry_result_retirement_f1a4.py:17-21` reads `_concurrency.py` and is retargeted onto `applier.py`; `test_concurrency.py` tests `applier.snapshot_head`. Update the `_ref_lock.py:19-22`, `src/rebar/_config_schema.py:655` and `docs/architecture.md:557` comments.
7. `acli_subprocess.py:148` becomes `from rebar.reconciler._errors import MAX_BACKOFF_S`; its uses at `:171,174` and the mentions at `:145,157` are renamed to `MAX_BACKOFF_S`, as is `sub._MAX_BACKOFF_S` at `test_reconcile_live_e2e.py:607` (comment `:603`). Delete the STATUS_GATING mentions at `apply_outbound.py:123`, `config.py:73` (engine config), `dispatch_apply_phases.py:73` and `test_differ_purity_status.py:4`.
8. `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` drops `env_var::REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE` (`.github/mechanism-baseline.json:574`) and the `test_dc_summary_executor.py` autouse fixture (`:56`).
9. `--filter-local-ids` (`request.py:94,112,123`) stays: documented (`docs/user-guide.md:666-667`), used by `tests/external/live_jira_dc/_dc_support.py:157-170`.
10. `docs/release-notes.md` gets the BREAKING entry and an ADR 0107 note: step 4's two deletions are done, but its exit criterion (no plain-dict payload constructor in production) is not met while `binding_walk`, `differ`, `invariants` and `run_differs` build them. No ADR rewrite.

BREAKING: `applier.apply`'s batch form accepts typed `Mutation`s only; `Mutation(inbound, delete|probe)` raises `ValueError`.

## Scope
Deleted: the five modules, `payload_corpus/` and the tests named above; every other file-impact path changes. Out of scope: ADR text (incl. `docs/adr/0107`), converting the remaining plain-dict producers, `request.py`, and retry behaviour (next story).

## Testing
Happy: `pytest tests/unit/reconciler -q` (includes `mutate/test_reconciler_coordinator_taxonomy.py`). Edge: `Mutation(inbound, delete, …)` raises `ValueError`; `applier.apply([{"action":"update"}], "p", root, client=fake)` raises `TypeError`; a typed outbound update with a plain-dict `changed_fields` payload (the `binding_walk` shape) still converts; `git grep -n 'summary_executor\|ONE_ATTEMPT_NO_SLEEP\|payload_shadow\|_MAX_BACKOFF_S\|STATUS_GATING\|_load_concurrency\|REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE' -- src` is empty; `check_complexity_baseline.py --check` lists `_diff_fields` as `stale`, `new=0`; `check_mechanism_delta.py --check` and `gen_env_registry.py --check` pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Five modules deleted (`summary_route.py`, `summary_operation.py`, `summary_executor.py`, `payload_shadow.py`, `_concurrency.py`) — `git ls-tree`.
- [x] `len(mutation._VALID_COMBINATIONS) == 10` and equals `set(typed_dispatch._LEAVES)` — unit test.
- [x] `outbound_fields.py` ≤ 250 LOC exporting only `_map_local_to_jira_fields` + maps — `wc -l`, grep.
- [x] `make verify` exits 0.
